name: How long does it take to repair wood rot?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair wood rot?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of wood rot repair depends primarily on the scope and complexity of the damage. Minor repairs, such as a small section of a window frame, might take a few hours to a day. More extensive damage to larger structural elements, like a deck or multiple siding sections, could require several days. Our team aims to provide a clear timeline after the initial assessment. Factors like needing to custom-match materials or the requirement for additional drying time for treated wood can also influence the project duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on damage scope; minor fixes can be hours, larger projects several days. We provide a timeline after assessment.
